FYI Yachts is pleased to announce the successful sale and delivery of the 2024 365 NHD, a premier vessel that seamlessly blends innovation, luxury, and performance. This exceptional boat was expertly delivered by Peter Kelly & Ricardo Llorente, marking another milestone in our commitment to providing top-tier boating experiences.

We extend our sincere gratitude to Janu Gagliardi with BTE and the entire NHD Boats team for their invaluable support in facilitating this sale. Their dedication and expertise played a crucial role in ensuring a seamless transaction and an outstanding experience for our buyer.

The 365 NHD is an extraordinary model, designed for those who seek both adventure and luxury. Its spacious layout maximizes comfort and functionality, while the open deck design enhances the onboard experience by creating a seamless connection to the sea. One of its standout features is the ability to open both sides, expanding the beam to an impressive 16 feet, offering an unparalleled open-sea experience.

This model is equipped with a Kenyon electric grill, a cutting board, and a sink—perfect for onboard entertaining. Powering this beauty are two inboard Volvo Penta engines, delivering outstanding performance and reliability.

As a hard-top version, this 365 NHD provides the flexibility to control the overhead opening from the helm, allowing for a fully open-air experience when desired. This feature enhances both comfort and adaptability, ensuring the perfect balance between shade and sunshine.

Below deck, the well-appointed cabin includes a V-berth forward that converts into a table, a midship berth with sleeping accommodations for two, a galley to port, and a well-designed head on the starboard side, offering both convenience and comfort for extended stays on the water.

This marks a new beginning for NHD Boats and FYI Yachts’ partnership in the USA, strengthening our commitment to bringing innovative and high-quality boats to the American market.

Congratulations to the new owner! We know you will create unforgettable memories aboard your new 365 NHD. If you are looking for your dream boat, FYI Yachts is here to guide you every step of the way.
